title: TEDxCopenhagen - Mikael Colville-Andersen - Why We Shouldn't Bike with a Helmet
summary: Copenhagen's bicycle ambassador Mikael Colville-Andersen argues in a TEDx talk that bicycle helmets threaten bicycle culture. He says they distract from road design and make cycling look dangerous.
why: Pointed to in helmet-law debates as a watchable argument that helmet mandates may cost lives by discouraging cycling.
